newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African gunmen kill nine in village attack.
newsitem.headline: S.African gunmen kill nine in village attack.

text.p: Armed attackers killed nine people, mostly women and children, in a village in South Africa's Eastern Cape region, police said on Sunday.

Up to 40 men stormed the Ntsikwe village late on Saturday, armed with an assortment of weapons including automatic rifles and pistols. They killed nine people, wounded eight and gutted some 30 houses.

Police told state radio the violence was believed to be a revenge attack following the gutting of five houses at nearby Sigikeni village on Friday night, linked to feuding over stock theft in the impoverished former black homeland of Transkei.
